subject: Upcoming Company Event: Annual Employee Appreciation Day
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce that our Annual Employee Appreciation Day is coming up on Friday, September 10th. This year, we will be hosting a catered lunch and fun team-building activities. Please mark your calendars and stay tuned for more details on the schedule and RSVP instructions. We look forward to celebrating and showing our gratitude for all your hard work and dedication. Best regards, [Company Name] HR Team
